name: Green Card — Adjustment of Status (Marriage-Based, Form I-485)
name_pt: Green Card — Ajuste de Status (Baseado em Casamento, Formulário I-485)
name_es: Green Card — Ajuste de Estatus (Basado en Matrimonio, Formulario I-485)

phases.name: Document Collection
documents: U.S. passport or Green Card copy (petitioner)
Proof of domicile in the U.S. (petitioner)
Death certificate of former spouse (if applicable)
documents_pt: Passaporte americano ou cópia do Green Card (peticionário)
Certidão de óbito do ex-cônjuge (se aplicável)
Declaração de imposto de renda mais recente
documents_es: Pasaporte estadounidense o copia del Green Card (peticionario)
Comprobante de domicilio en EE. UU. (peticionario)
Acta de defunción del excónyuge (si aplica)
Pruebas del historial de la relación
steps: Confirm eligibility for concurrent filing (I-130 + I-485)

phases.name: Case Preparation
steps: Confirm financial eligibility (income requirements) or joint sponsor secured
Confirm relationship is genuine and well documented
Confirm timeline is consistent across documents
Confirm consistency between petitioner and beneficiary

phases.name: Execution
steps: Passport-style photographs and Form I-693 attached

pricing.notes: No separate paper-filing tier -- the Plus package already includes review, printing, and assembly of the final package as part of its flat fee.
pricing.source: Real Saes Professional Services contract (Downloads/Contratos, 'GREEN CARD_ENG.pdf' -- Assistance for Adjustment of Status), extracted 2026-08-02.
